scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
Ni Hao!
Welcome to Kunlun~
Take a walk around and experience
the ancient history and tradition
of our breath taking city.
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
你好！
欢迎来到昆仑~
四处走走，感受这座美丽城市悠久的历史与传统吧。

scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
I am responsible for helping you
with any questions you may have.
Please feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
我负责为您答疑解惑。
有什么想问的，尽管开口。

scripts.text:
[He Yuen Zhe]
Please follow your minimap, and head over to the ^FF3355+^000000 mark.
There, you'll get to the residence of the Chief. Enjoy your stay in lovely Kunlun!
Xie Xie!
scripts.translation:
[何远哲]
沿着小地图上^FF3355+^000000十字标记的方向走，就能找到首领的住所。
祝您在美丽的昆仑度过愉快的时光！
谢谢！
